name: dev-workflow
description: Development pipeline roles — the subagents that make up an orchestrated flow, each a single responsibility with its own inputs, outputs and boundaries. The orchestration engine that sequences them is still being designed, so the roles here carry no wiring to any particular one.

interface.longDescription: Nine subagents covering the roles an orchestrated development flow needs — spec authoring, design review, implementation, e2e authoring and execution, incremental code review, debugging, research, and release preparation. Each is one responsibility with explicit boundaries, and the separations between them are load-bearing: whoever produces does not verify. They carry no wiring to a specific orchestration engine, so a caller supplies the artifact locations.
defaultPrompt: Review this change before I merge it
